instrument.citation: By-law 569-2013, as amended, as it read prior to July 22, 2022

calculation_handling.description: A project with a building permit application filed on or before July 22, 2022 may comply with the 970.10 parking regulations or the former text of By-law 569-2013 instead of the listed parking regulations.
calculation_handling.gaps: Alternate compliance path under a former by-law; never evaluated.

units.disclosure: Projects with a building permit application filed on or before July 22, 2022 may follow the earlier parking rules; this alternate path is not evaluated.

instrument.citation: By-law 569-2013, as amended, as it read after July 22, 2022, and on or prior to March 31, 2025

calculation_handling.description: A project with a building permit application filed after July 22, 2022 and on or before March 31, 2025 may comply with the listed 970.10 regulations or the by-law as it read in that period instead of the listed parking regulations.
calculation_handling.gaps: Alternate compliance path under a former by-law; never evaluated.

units.disclosure: Projects with a building permit application filed between July 22, 2022 and March 31, 2025 may follow the earlier parking rules; this alternate path is not evaluated.

calculation_handling.description: Defines an application for a building permit as one meeting Article I of Municipal Code Chapter 363.

200.25.15.1(1).explanation: Transition rule: the listed parking regulations do not stop a project whose building permit application was filed on or before July 22, 2022, if it complies with the listed 970.10 regulations or with By-law 569-2013 as it read before that date, and with any finally approved minor variances.

200.25.15.1(2).explanation: Transition rule: the listed accessible parking regulations do not stop a project whose building permit application was filed after July 22, 2022 and on or before March 31, 2025, if it complies with the listed 970.10 regulations or the by-law as it read in that period, and with any finally approved minor variances.

200.25.15.1(3).explanation: An application for a building permit, for this transition, means one that meets Article I of Chapter 363 of the City of Toronto Municipal Code.
